note: Wednesday B, Cantonese speaking（粤语口语）, light maintenance. 事 si6 ×3, recap Friday's workplace lines, then 3 new daily-work lines to shadow. No Hard leftover. Keep only if dinner allows. 加油！

tasks.prompt: Warm-up: say 事 (si6, low flat tone 低平调) three times in a row. Low and flat, not mid like 試 si3.
tasks.script: 事 si6 · 事 si6 · 事 si6 (low, flat, no rise)

tasks.title: Read / shadow the 3 new workplace lines (Hub Play may be silent — use the mp3: audio/cantonese/wed18_yue_lines.mp3)

lines.gloss: nei5 ji4 gaa1 fong1 bin6 maa3
lines.translation: Are you free now? · 你现在方便吗？

lines.gloss: ngo5 cyun4 zo2 bei2 nei5 laa1
lines.translation: I've sent it over to you. · 我已经发给你了。

lines.gloss: m4 goi1 saai3, bong1 zo2 daai6 mong4
lines.translation: Thanks so much, that was a big help. · 太谢谢了，帮了大忙。

tasks.prompt: Shadow the 3 new lines ×3 (audio: audio/cantonese/wed18_yue_lines.mp3 in the tutor folder; Hub Play may be silent), then say them without the script. If you have a minute, run the mini exchange once: ask if they are free, say you have sent it, then thank them.
tasks.script: 你而家方便嗎？ nei5 ji4 gaa1 fong1 bin6 maa3 · 我傳咗俾你啦。 ngo5 cyun4 zo2 bei2 nei5 laa1 · 唔該晒，幫咗大忙。 m4 goi1 saai3, bong1 zo2 daai6 mong4

questions.explain: 事 si6 is low and flat. 低平调。
新嚟 san1 lai4 = newly arrived. Recap from Friday. 我是新来的。

options: I've sent it over to you.
questions.explain: 傳咗 cyun4 zo2 = have sent / forwarded. 已经发给你了。
唔該晒 m4 goi1 saai3 = thanks so much. 晒 saai3 adds 'completely / a lot'.

questions.q: 你而家方便嗎？ is asking…
questions.explain: 而家 ji4 gaa1 = now; 方便 fong1 bin6 = free / convenient. 你现在方便吗？
